verdict.rationale: Evidence only contains marketing-style claims like 'human-level accuracy' and 'diarized and timestamped transcripts' with no documentation of the underlying transcription model, accuracy benchmarks/WER, language coverage, or known limitations — exactly the kind of vague 'AI-powered' claim the story asks vendors to go beyond. Missing for 10: model/vendor disclosure, accuracy methodology or benchmark data, documented limitations (accents, languages, background noise, speaker overlap), and any independent verification of accuracy claims.
